//@version=6
// Sweep Engine v2.0 — STRATEGY (backtestable in Strategy Tester)
strategy("Sweep Engine v2.0", shorttitle="Sweep v2", overlay=true, max_lines_count=80, max_labels_count=50,
     initial_capital=100000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1, pyramiding=0,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=0.62,
     slippage=2, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// INPUTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
i_atrLen     = input.int(14,     "ATR Length",                   group="Signal")
i_slMult     = input.float(4.5,  "Stop Loss (x ATR)",           group="Signal", step=0.5)
i_tpMult     = input.float(4.0,  "Take Profit (x ATR)",         group="Signal", step=0.5)
i_cooldown   = input.int(8,      "Cooldown (bars)",              group="Signal", minval=1, maxval=50)
i_minConf    = input.int(0,      "Min confluence score (0–3)",   group="Signal", minval=0, maxval=3,
     tooltip="0 = trade on sweep alone (recommended). 1+ requires near round/VWAP/Lon50 — many sweeps score 0 and never enter.")
i_minAtr     = input.float(0.0,  "Min ATR filter (0 = off)",     group="Signal", minval=0.0, maxval=200.0, step=0.25)

i_useIB      = input.bool(true,  "Trade IB Sweeps",             group="Session Sweeps")
i_useLondon  = input.bool(true,  "Trade London Sweeps",         group="Session Sweeps")
i_useAsia    = input.bool(true,  "Trade Asia Sweeps",           group="Session Sweeps")
i_useLon50   = input.bool(false, "Require London 50 Bias",      group="Session Sweeps")

i_roundIntvl = input.int(100,    "Round Number Interval",       group="Confluence", options=[50,100,250,500])
i_confProx   = input.float(1.5,  "Confluence Proximity (x ATR)",group="Confluence", step=0.25, tooltip="How close price must be to a level to count as confluence")

i_flatHr     = input.int(15,     "Flatten — hour (Chicago)",     group="Session Exit", minval=12, maxval=17,
     tooltip="Close positions & block new entries after this time (CT) until next session day.")
i_flatMn     = input.int(0,      "Flatten — minute (Chicago)",   group="Session Exit", minval=0, maxval=55, step=5)

i_showT3     = input.bool(false, "Show Tier 3 (Fibs/OB)",       group="Tier 3 Toggle", tooltip="Fibonacci and Order Blocks — statistically unproven")
i_fibZZlen   = input.int(10,     "Fib Zigzag Lookback",         group="Tier 3 Toggle", minval=3)

i_showSess   = input.bool(true,  "Session Levels",              group="Display")
i_showVWAP   = input.bool(true,  "VWAP",                        group="Display")
i_showRound  = input.bool(true,  "Round Numbers",               group="Display")
i_showSLTP   = input.bool(true,  "SL/TP Lines",                 group="Display")
i_showRawSw  = input.bool(true,  "Show sweep detection (dots)", group="Display",
     tooltip="Small crosses when a bull/bear sweep bar prints. Triangles = strategy entry.")
i_lightChart = input.bool(false, "Light chart (fewer plots)",   group="Display",
     tooltip="ON = hide session/VWAP/round/model lines; keeps signals + SL/TP + shading. Use if Internal server study errors.")
i_showDashTable = input.bool(true, "Show dashboard table",       group="Display",
     tooltip="On-chart table: session + strategy stats. Turn off if you hit internal server / performance issues.")
i_sessLvlEndUseFlat = input.bool(true, "Level lines end at flatten time (CT)", group="Display",
     tooltip="IB / London / Asia horizontal lines stop when Session Exit flatten begins. Off = use custom end time below (NY afternoon / PM).")
i_sessLvlEndHr = input.int(16, "Level lines end — hour (Chicago)", group="Display", minval=10, maxval=20,
     tooltip="Only if 'end at flatten' is off. Example: 16 = 4:00 PM CT (common post-RTH / NY PM context).")
i_sessLvlEndMn = input.int(0, "Level lines end — minute (Chicago)", group="Display", minval=0, maxval=55, step=5)

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// REGIME (optional — HTF trend + chop + ADX; toggle for different market conditions)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
i_useHtfTrend = input.bool(false, "HTF trend filter", group="Regime",
     tooltip="Longs only when HTF close > HTF EMA; shorts only when below. Cuts many counter-trend sweeps.")
i_htfTf       = input.string("60", "HTF for trend", group="Regime", options=["15","30","60","120","240","D"])
i_htfEmaLen   = input.int(20, "HTF EMA length", group="Regime", minval=5, maxval=200)

i_useAtrRegime = input.bool(false, "ATR vs average (chop filter)", group="Regime",
     tooltip="Skip bars where ATR < SMA(ATR)×mult — avoids dead chop. Turn on with HTF for adaptability.")
i_atrRegimeLen = input.int(20, "ATR baseline length", group="Regime", minval=5, maxval=100)
i_atrRegimeMult = input.float(0.85, "Min ATR vs avg", minval=0.4, maxval=1.25, step=0.05, group="Regime",
     tooltip="Higher = only trade when volatility picks up vs its recent mean.")

i_useAdxFilt  = input.bool(false, "ADX filter", group="Regime",
     tooltip="Gate entries by trend strength. Min ADX = directional market; optional max = skip extreme spikes.")
i_adxLen      = input.int(14, "ADX length", group="Regime", minval=5, maxval=50)
i_adxFloor    = input.float(15, "Min ADX", minval=0, maxval=60, step=1, group="Regime", tooltip="0 = no minimum.")
i_adxCeil     = input.float(0, "Max ADX (0 = off)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=1, group="Regime",
     tooltip="Skip when ADX exceeds this (optional). 0 disables ceiling.")

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// QUALITY GATES (optional — test in Strategy Tester; default off = same as before)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
i_sweepDepthAtr = input.float(0.0, "Min sweep depth (x ATR)", group="Quality",
     tooltip="0 = off. Require penetration past the swept level by at least this multiple of ATR (filters shallow taps).")
i_useEmaGate = input.bool(false, "EMA trend gate (chart TF)", group="Quality",
     tooltip="Longs: fast EMA > slow & close > slow. Shorts: opposite. Reduces counter-trend liquidity grabs.")
i_emaFast = input.int(9, "Fast EMA", group="Quality", minval=2, maxval=50)
i_emaSlow = input.int(21, "Slow EMA", group="Quality", minval=5, maxval=100)
i_useRsiGate = input.bool(false, "RSI band gate", group="Quality",
     tooltip="Avoid longs in overbought / shorts in oversold chop.")
i_rsiLen = input.int(14, "RSI length", minval=2, maxval=50, group="Quality")
i_rsiLongMin = input.float(32, "Long: RSI ≥", minval=5, maxval=90, step=1, group="Quality")
i_rsiLongMax = input.float(72, "Long: RSI ≤", minval=5, maxval=95, step=1, group="Quality")
i_rsiShortMin = input.float(28, "Short: RSI ≥", minval=5, maxval=90, step=1, group="Quality")
i_rsiShortMax = input.float(68, "Short: RSI ≤", minval=5, maxval=95, step=1, group="Quality")
i_useVolGate = input.bool(false, "Volume vs average gate", group="Quality",
     tooltip="Bar volume must exceed SMA(volume)×mult (confirms participation).")
i_volLen = input.int(20, "Volume SMA length", minval=5, maxval=100, group="Quality")
i_volMult = input.float(1.12, "Volume multiplier", minval=0.8, maxval=3.0, step=0.02, group="Quality")
i_maxTradesDay = input.int(0, "Max trades / calendar day (0 = off)", minval=0, maxval=50, group="Quality",
     tooltip="Cap entries per session day to reduce overtrading in chop.")

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SWEEP TARGET MODEL (heuristic rank — not a guarantee; for planning + optional limits)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
i_plotSweepModel = input.bool(false, "Plot model highlight levels", group="Sweep prediction",
     tooltip="Off by default to reduce chart load. Ignored when Light chart is ON.")
i_entryMode = input.string("Reactive sweep (close)", "Entry style", group="Sweep prediction",
     options=["Reactive sweep (close)", "Predictive limit (model)"],
     tooltip="Reactive: original logic (enter after sweep on bar close). Predictive: place working limits at the model's chosen liquidity (different stats; validate in tester).")
i_predMinConf = input.int(52, "Min confidence for predictive entry", group="Sweep prediction", minval=30, maxval=94,
     tooltip="Lower = more limit-order signals. Default 52; raise if too many marginal fills.")
i_predMinEdge = input.float(0.0, "Min pool edge (predictive)", group="Sweep prediction", minval=0.0, maxval=0.45, step=0.01,
     tooltip="0 = off (default). Higher = fewer predictive limit orders in chop.")
i_modelHtf = input.bool(true, "Model: HTF bias toward liquidity side", group="Sweep prediction",
     tooltip="Uses same HTF EMA as Regime (no need to turn on trade filter). Bull HTF favors downside sweep / bear HTF favors upside sweep.")
i_modelMomentum = input.bool(true, "Model: 3-bar momentum toward level", group="Sweep prediction")
i_modelVwapTilt = input.bool(true, "Model: VWAP position tilt", group="Sweep prediction")
i_modelSweptDecay = input.float(0.42, "Score mult. after level swept", group="Sweep prediction", minval=0.15, maxval=0.95, step=0.02,
     tooltip="Once a session level prints a sweep, down-weight that level for the rest of the day.")
i_blockReactiveLongVsBearModel = input.bool(true, "Block reactive longs in Bear pool", group="Sweep prediction",
     tooltip="When the sweep target model favors downside liquidity (Bear pool), skip reactive bullish sweep entries. Predictive longs already require Bull pool.")

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RISK — equity drawdown vs peak (account $, same units as Strategy Tester equity)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
i_maxDdUsd = input.float(2000.0, "Max equity drawdown ($)", group="Risk", minval=0.0, maxval=500000.0, step=50.0,
     tooltip="Measured from peak strategy.equity. When drawdown reaches this, new entries are blocked. Set 0 to disable.")
i_ddFlatten = input.bool(true, "Flatten at DD limit", group="Risk",
     tooltip="Close open position when drawdown hits the limit (in addition to blocking new trades).")

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIME + SESSION DETECTION (CT — Central Time)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
hr = hour(time, "America/Chicago")
mn = minute(time, "America/Chicago")
atr = ta.atr(i_atrLen)
newDay = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

isAsia     = hr >= 18 or hr < 1
isLondon   = hr >= 1 and hr < 4
isIB       = (hr == 8 and mn >= 30) or (hr == 9 and mn < 30)
isPostIB   = (hr == 9 and mn >= 30) or (hr >= 10 and hr < 15)
isNY_AM_KZ = (hr == 7 and mn >= 30) or hr == 8 or (hr == 9 and mn < 30)
isSB_AM    = hr == 9 or (hr == 10 and mn == 0)
isLonClose = hr == 9 or (hr == 10 and mn < 30)
isKillzone = isNY_AM_KZ or isSB_AM or isLonClose

pastFlat = (hr > i_flatHr) or (hr == i_flatHr and mn >= i_flatMn)

// Horizontal session levels: draw until NY PM / flatten (CT) — ibLvlDraw defined after ibOK below
pastSessLvlEnd = i_sessLvlEndUseFlat ? pastFlat : ((hr > i_sessLvlEndHr) or (hr == i_sessLvlEndHr and mn >= i_sessLvlEndMn))
sessLvlActive = not pastSessLvlEnd

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SESSION LEVELS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var float ibH=na, var float ibL=na, var float ib50=na, var bool ibOK=false
var float lonH=na, var float lonL=na, var float lon50=na, var bool lonOK=false
var float asiaH=na, var float asiaL=na, var bool asiaOK=false
var bool swIBL = false
var bool swIBH = false
var bool swLonL = false
var bool swLonH = false
var bool swAsL = false
var bool swAsH = false

// Horizontal session levels: line objects (full bar span per day vs plot gaps)
var line lnIbH = na
var line lnIbL = na
var line lnIb50 = na
var line lnLonH = na
var line lnLonL = na
var line lnLon50 = na
var line lnAsH = na
var line lnAsL = na
var array<line> sessLineHist = array.new_line(0)

if newDay
    if not na(lnIbH)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnIbH)
    if not na(lnIbL)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnIbL)
    if not na(lnIb50)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnIb50)
    if not na(lnLonH)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnLonH)
    if not na(lnLonL)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnLonL)
    if not na(lnLon50)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnLon50)
    if not na(lnAsH)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnAsH)
    if not na(lnAsL)
        array.push(sessLineHist, lnAsL)
    lnIbH := na
    lnIbL := na
    lnIb50 := na
    lnLonH := na
    lnLonL := na
    lnLon50 := na
    lnAsH := na
    lnAsL := na
    while array.size(sessLineHist) > 450
        line.delete(array.shift(sessLineHist))
    ibH:=na,ibL:=na,ib50:=na,ibOK:=false,lonH:=na,lonL:=na,lon50:=na,lonOK:=false,asiaH:=na,asiaL:=na,asiaOK:=false
    swIBL:=false,swIBH:=false,swLonL:=false,swLonH:=false,swAsL:=false,swAsH:=false

if isIB
    ibH:=na(ibH)?high:math.max(ibH,high), ibL:=na(ibL)?low:math.min(ibL,low), ib50:=(ibH+ibL)/2
if isIB[1] and not isIB
    ibOK:=true

if isLondon
    lonH:=na(lonH)?high:math.max(lonH,high), lonL:=na(lonL)?low:math.min(lonL,low), lon50:=(lonH+lonL)/2
if isLondon[1] and not isLondon
    lonOK:=true

if isAsia
    asiaH:=na(asiaH)?high:math.max(asiaH,high), asiaL:=na(asiaL)?low:math.min(asiaL,low)
if isAsia[1] and not isAsia
    asiaOK:=true

// IB levels: from first bar after IB forms until session level end (ibOK only true post-IB)
ibLvlDraw = ibOK and sessLvlActive

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// VWAP
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var float cPV=0., var float cVol=0.
if newDay
    cPV:=0., cVol:=0.
tp_=(high+low+close)/3
cPV+=tp_*volume, cVol+=volume
vwap=cVol>0?cPV/cVol:close

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ROUND NUMBERS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rndAbove = math.ceil(close / i_roundIntvl) * i_roundIntvl
rndBelow = math.floor(close / i_roundIntvl) * i_roundIntvl
nearRound = math.min(math.abs(close - rndAbove), math.abs(close - rndBelow)) < atr * i_confProx

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TIER 3: FIBONACCI (behind toggle)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
swHi = ta.pivothigh(high, i_fibZZlen, i_fibZZlen)
swLo = ta.pivotlow(low, i_fibZZlen, i_fibZZlen)
var float lSH=na, var float lSL=na
if not na(swHi)
    lSH:=swHi
if not na(swLo)
    lSL:=swLo
fibOK = i_showT3 and not na(lSH) and not na(lSL)
fibR = fibOK ? lSH-lSL : 0.
fibBull = fibOK and lSL > lSH  // swing low came after swing high = uptrend
fib618 = fibOK ? (fibBull ? lSH + fibR*0.382 : lSH - fibR*0.618) : na
fib705 = fibOK ? (fibBull ? lSH + fibR*0.295 : lSH - fibR*0.705) : na

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONFLUENCE + SWEEP DETECTION
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
lon50Bull = not i_useLon50 or (lonOK and close > lon50)
lon50Bear = not i_useLon50 or (lonOK and close < lon50)

depthReq = i_sweepDepthAtr > 0 and atr > 0
depthBull = not depthReq or (ibL - low) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr
depthBullL = not depthReq or (lonL - low) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr
depthBullA = not depthReq or (asiaL - low) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr
depthBear = not depthReq or (high - ibH) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr
depthBearL = not depthReq or (high - lonH) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr
depthBearA = not depthReq or (high - asiaH) >= atr * i_sweepDepthAtr

sweepIBlo  = ibOK and isPostIB and (low < ibL) and (close > ibL) and lon50Bull and depthBull
sweepIBhi  = ibOK and isPostIB and (high > ibH) and (close < ibH) and lon50Bear and depthBear
sweepLonLo = lonOK and isKillzone and (low < lonL) and (close > lonL) and lon50Bull and depthBullL
sweepLonHi = lonOK and isKillzone and (high > lonH) and (close < lonH) and lon50Bear and depthBearL
sweepAsLo  = asiaOK and isKillzone and (low < asiaL) and (close > asiaL) and lon50Bull and depthBullA
sweepAsHi  = asiaOK and isKillzone and (high > asiaH) and (close < asiaH) and lon50Bear and depthBearA

if sweepIBlo
    swIBL := true
if sweepIBhi
    swIBH := true
if sweepLonLo
    swLonL := true
if sweepLonHi
    swLonH := true
if sweepAsLo
    swAsL := true
if sweepAsHi
    swAsH := true

bullSweep = (i_useIB and sweepIBlo) or (i_useAsia and sweepAsLo) or (i_useLondon and sweepLonLo)
bearSweep = (i_useIB and sweepIBhi) or (i_useAsia and sweepAsHi) or (i_useLondon and sweepLonHi)

sweepSrc = sweepIBlo or sweepIBhi ? "IB" : sweepAsLo or sweepAsHi ? "ASIA" : sweepLonLo or sweepLonHi ? "LON" : ""

nearVWAP = math.abs(close - vwap) < atr * i_confProx
lon50Aligned_bull = lonOK and close > lon50
lon50Aligned_bear = lonOK and close < lon50

confBull = (nearRound ? 1 : 0) + (nearVWAP ? 1 : 0) + (lon50Aligned_bull ? 1 : 0)
confBear = (nearRound ? 1 : 0) + (nearVWAP ? 1 : 0) + (lon50Aligned_bear ? 1 : 0)
confScore = bullSweep ? confBull : bearSweep ? confBear : 0

volOK = i_minAtr <= 0 or atr >= i_minAtr

// Regime gates (all optional via inputs above) — single security() call
[htfEma, htfCls] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, i_htfTf, [ta.ema(close, i_htfEmaLen), close], barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)
trendLongOK = not i_useHtfTrend or (not na(htfCls) and not na(htfEma) and htfCls > htfEma)
trendShortOK = not i_useHtfTrend or (not na(htfCls) and not na(htfEma) and htfCls < htfEma)

atrBase = ta.sma(atr, i_atrRegimeLen)
atrRegimeOK = not i_useAtrRegime or (not na(atrBase) and atrBase > 0 and atr >= atrBase * i_atrRegimeMult)

[_, _, adxVal] = ta.dmi(i_adxLen, i_adxLen)
adxOK = not i_useAdxFilt or (not na(adxVal) and adxVal >= i_adxFloor and (i_adxCeil <= 0 or adxVal <= i_adxCeil))

emaF = ta.ema(close, i_emaFast)
emaS = ta.ema(close, i_emaSlow)
rsiV = ta.rsi(close, i_rsiLen)
volSma = ta.sma(volume, i_volLen)

emaGateLong = not i_useEmaGate or (emaF > emaS and close > emaS)
emaGateShort = not i_useEmaGate or (emaF < emaS and close < emaS)
rsiGateLong = not i_useRsiGate or (not na(rsiV) and rsiV >= i_rsiLongMin and rsiV <= i_rsiLongMax)
rsiGateShort = not i_useRsiGate or (not na(rsiV) and rsiV >= i_rsiShortMin and rsiV <= i_rsiShortMax)
volGate = not i_useVolGate or (not na(volSma) and volSma > 0 and volume >= volSma * i_volMult)
qualityOK = emaGateLong and rsiGateLong and volGate
qualityOKShort = emaGateShort and rsiGateShort and volGate

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SWEEP TARGET MODEL v2 — multi-factor score + margin-based confidence
// (Heuristic composite; "confidence" = internal model strength, not true probability.)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
modelDistW(float distAtr) =>
    100.0 / (1.0 + distAtr * 0.68)

atrSafe = math.max(atr, syminfo.mintick)
wPostIB = isPostIB ? 1.42 : 1.0
wKZ = isKillzone ? 1.15 : 1.0
wLondonSess = isLondon ? 1.1 : 1.0
wAsiaSess = isAsia ? 1.08 : 1.0
wLonBull = lonOK and close > lon50 ? 1.1 : lonOK and close < lon50 ? 0.9 : 1.0
wLonBear = lonOK and close < lon50 ? 1.1 : lonOK and close > lon50 ? 0.9 : 1.0

htfBull = not na(htfCls) and not na(htfEma) and htfCls > htfEma
htfBoostLow = i_modelHtf ? (na(htfCls) or na(htfEma) ? 1.0 : htfBull ? 1.16 : 0.86) : 1.0
htfBoostHigh = i_modelHtf ? (na(htfCls) or na(htfEma) ? 1.0 : htfBull ? 0.86 : 1.16) : 1.0

mom3 = close - close[3]
momLow = i_modelMomentum ? (1.0 + math.min(0.26, (mom3 < 0 ? -mom3 : 0.0) / atrSafe * 0.2)) : 1.0
momHigh = i_modelMomentum ? (1.0 + math.min(0.26, (mom3 > 0 ? mom3 : 0.0) / atrSafe * 0.2)) : 1.0

emaBoostLow = emaF > emaS ? 1.08 : emaF < emaS ? 0.93 : 1.0
emaBoostHigh = emaF < emaS ? 1.08 : emaF > emaS ? 0.93 : 1.0

vwapBoostLow = i_modelVwapTilt ? (close < vwap ? 1.07 : 0.96) : 1.0
vwapBoostHigh = i_modelVwapTilt ? (close > vwap ? 1.07 : 0.96) : 1.0

volPushLow = not na(volSma) and volSma > 0 and close < close[1] and volume > volSma * 1.07 ? 1.05 : 1.0
volPushHigh = not na(volSma) and volSma > 0 and close > close[1] and volume > volSma * 1.07 ? 1.05 : 1.0

decIBL = swIBL ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0
decIBH = swIBH ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0
decLonL = swLonL ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0
decLonH = swLonH ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0
decAsL = swAsL ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0
decAsH = swAsH ? i_modelSweptDecay : 1.0

d_ibL = (ibOK and i_useIB and not na(ibL) and ibL < close) ? (close - ibL) / atrSafe : na
s_ibL = not na(d_ibL) ? modelDistW(d_ibL) * wPostIB * wKZ * wLonBull * htfBoostLow * momLow * emaBoostLow * vwapBoostLow * volPushLow * decIBL : 0.0
d_lonL = (lonOK and i_useLondon and not na(lonL) and lonL < close) ? (close - lonL) / atrSafe : na
s_lonL = not na(d_lonL) ? modelDistW(d_lonL) * wKZ * 1.22 * wLonBull * wLondonSess * htfBoostLow * momLow * emaBoostLow * vwapBoostLow * volPushLow * decLonL : 0.0
d_asL = (asiaOK and i_useAsia and not na(asiaL) and asiaL < close) ? (close - asiaL) / atrSafe : na
s_asL = not na(d_asL) ? modelDistW(d_asL) * wKZ * 1.1 * wLonBull * wAsiaSess * htfBoostLow * momLow * emaBoostLow * vwapBoostLow * volPushLow * decAsL : 0.0

d_ibH = (ibOK and i_useIB and not na(ibH) and ibH > close) ? (ibH - close) / atrSafe : na
s_ibH = not na(d_ibH) ? modelDistW(d_ibH) * wPostIB * wKZ * wLonBear * htfBoostHigh * momHigh * emaBoostHigh * vwapBoostHigh * volPushHigh * decIBH : 0.0
d_lonH = (lonOK and i_useLondon and not na(lonH) and lonH > close) ? (lonH - close) / atrSafe : na
s_lonH = not na(d_lonH) ? modelDistW(d_lonH) * wKZ * 1.22 * wLonBear * wLondonSess * htfBoostHigh * momHigh * emaBoostHigh * vwapBoostHigh * volPushHigh * decLonH : 0.0
d_asH = (asiaOK and i_useAsia and not na(asiaH) and asiaH > close) ? (asiaH - close) / atrSafe : na
s_asH = not na(d_asH) ? modelDistW(d_asH) * wKZ * 1.1 * wLonBear * wAsiaSess * htfBoostHigh * momHigh * emaBoostHigh * vwapBoostHigh * volPushHigh * decAsH : 0.0

bestLowScore = math.max(s_ibL, math.max(s_lonL, s_asL))
secondLow = s_ibL + s_lonL + s_asL - bestLowScore - math.min(s_ibL, math.min(s_lonL, s_asL))
bestLowPx = s_ibL >= s_lonL and s_ibL >= s_asL and s_ibL > 0 ? ibL : s_lonL >= s_asL and s_lonL > 0 ? lonL : s_asL > 0 ? asiaL : na
bestLowId = s_ibL >= s_lonL and s_ibL >= s_asL and s_ibL > 0 ? "IB L" : s_lonL >= s_asL and s_lonL > 0 ? "LON L" : s_asL > 0 ? "ASIA L" : ""

bestHighScore = math.max(s_ibH, math.max(s_lonH, s_asH))
secondHigh = s_ibH + s_lonH + s_asH - bestHighScore - math.min(s_ibH, math.min(s_lonH, s_asH))
bestHighPx = s_ibH >= s_lonH and s_ibH >= s_asH and s_ibH > 0 ? ibH : s_lonH >= s_asH and s_lonH > 0 ? lonH : s_asH > 0 ? asiaH : na
bestHighId = s_ibH >= s_lonH and s_ibH >= s_asH and s_ibH > 0 ? "IB H" : s_lonH >= s_asH and s_lonH > 0 ? "LON H" : s_asH > 0 ? "ASIA H" : ""

predDominant = bestLowScore > bestHighScore ? 1 : bestHighScore > bestLowScore ? -1 : 0
poolSum = bestLowScore + bestHighScore + 0.000001
poolEdge = math.abs(bestLowScore - bestHighScore) / poolSum
winPoolSc = math.max(bestLowScore, bestHighScore)
secondInWin = predDominant == 1 ? secondLow : predDominant == -1 ? secondHigh : 0.0
intraMargin = winPoolSc > 0 ? (winPoolSc - secondInWin) / winPoolSc : 0.0

rawConf = predDominant == 0 ? 38.0 : 36.0 + 18.0 * poolEdge + 22.0 * intraMargin + 0.22 * winPoolSc + (poolEdge > 0.18 ? 6.0 : 0.0) + (intraMargin > 0.25 ? 5.0 : 0.0)
predConf = int(math.min(94, math.max(36, rawConf)))

predEdgeOK = i_predMinEdge <= 0 or poolEdge >= i_predMinEdge

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STRATEGY ORDERS (Strategy Tester uses these fills)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
eqAcct = strategy.equity
var float peakEq = na
if na(peakEq) or eqAcct > peakEq
    peakEq := eqAcct
ddNowUsd = peakEq - eqAcct
ddLimitHit = i_maxDdUsd > 0 and ddNowUsd >= i_maxDdUsd
ddOK = i_maxDdUsd <= 0 or not ddLimitHit

var int barsDdBlocked = 0
if i_maxDdUsd > 0 and ddLimitHit
    barsDdBlocked += 1

var int lastSig=0
var int tradesToday=0
if newDay
    tradesToday := 0
cdOK = bar_index - lastSig > i_cooldown
dayTradesOK = i_maxTradesDay <= 0 or tradesToday < i_maxTradesDay
canEnter = not pastFlat and strategy.position_size == 0 and dayTradesOK and ddOK

useReactive = i_entryMode == "Reactive sweep (close)"
usePred = i_entryMode == "Predictive limit (model)"

reactiveLongModelOK = not i_blockReactiveLongVsBearModel or predDominant != -1
longSigReact = useReactive and volOK and bullSweep and cdOK and canEnter and confBull >= i_minConf and trendLongOK and atrRegimeOK and adxOK and qualityOK and reactiveLongModelOK
shortSigReact = useReactive and volOK and bearSweep and cdOK and canEnter and confBear >= i_minConf and trendShortOK and atrRegimeOK and adxOK and qualityOKShort

longSigPred = usePred and predDominant == 1 and predConf >= i_predMinConf and predEdgeOK and not na(bestLowPx) and canEnter and cdOK and volOK and trendLongOK and atrRegimeOK and adxOK and qualityOK
shortSigPred = usePred and predDominant == -1 and predConf >= i_predMinConf and predEdgeOK and not na(bestHighPx) and canEnter and cdOK and volOK and trendShortOK and atrRegimeOK and adxOK and qualityOKShort

longSig = longSigReact or longSigPred
shortSig = shortSigReact or shortSigPred

var string trSrc=""
var int trConf=0
if longSig
    lastSig := bar_index
    tradesToday += 1
    trSrc := longSigPred ? bestLowId : sweepSrc
    trConf := longSigPred ? predConf : confBull
if shortSig
    lastSig := bar_index
    tradesToday += 1
    trSrc := shortSigPred ? bestHighId : sweepSrc
    trConf := shortSigPred ? predConf : confBear

var float holdSL = na
var float holdTP = na
flatBar = pastFlat

if i_maxDdUsd > 0 and ddLimitHit and i_ddFlatten and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="DD limit")

if flatBar and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session flat")

if longSigReact
    holdSL := close - atr * i_slMult
    holdTP := close + atr * i_tpMult
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

if longSigPred
    holdSL := bestLowPx - atr * i_slMult
    holdTP := bestLowPx + atr * i_tpMult
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, limit=bestLowPx)

if shortSigReact
    holdSL := close + atr * i_slMult
    holdTP := close - atr * i_tpMult
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

if shortSigPred
    holdSL := bestHighPx + atr * i_slMult
    holdTP := bestHighPx - atr * i_tpMult
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, limit=bestHighPx)

if not flatBar and strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("xL", "Long", stop=holdSL, limit=holdTP)
if not flatBar and strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("xS", "Short", stop=holdSL, limit=holdTP)

justClosed = strategy.position_size == 0 and nz(strategy.position_size[1], 0) != 0
if flatBar or justClosed
    holdSL := na
    holdTP := na

inLong = strategy.position_size > 0
inShort = strategy.position_size < 0
ep = strategy.position_avg_price
sl = holdSL
tp = holdTP
longExit = justClosed and strategy.position_size[1] > 0
shortExit = justClosed and strategy.position_size[1] < 0

// CHART VISUALS (light mode drops most plots — reduces TV server load / study errors)

cG=#00E676, cRd=#FF1744, cO=#FFA726
cIB=color.new(#42A5F5,30), cLon=color.new(#AB47BC,30), cAsia=color.new(#FF7043,30)

fullVis = not i_lightChart

cLon50 = color.new(#AB47BC, 60)

// Session H/L (and mids): true horizontal segments from first bar the level is valid → session level end (line.new + set_xy2)

if not sessLineOn
    if not na(lnIbH)
        line.delete(lnIbH)
        lnIbH := na
    if not na(lnIbL)
        line.delete(lnIbL)
        lnIbL := na
    if not na(lnIb50)
        line.delete(lnIb50)
        lnIb50 := na
    if not na(lnLonH)
        line.delete(lnLonH)
        lnLonH := na
    if not na(lnLonL)
        line.delete(lnLonL)
        lnLonL := na
    if not na(lnLon50)
        line.delete(lnLon50)
        lnLon50 := na
    if not na(lnAsH)
        line.delete(lnAsH)
        lnAsH := na
    if not na(lnAsL)
        line.delete(lnAsL)
        lnAsL := na
    while array.size(sessLineHist) > 0
        line.delete(array.shift(sessLineHist))
else
    if ibLvlDraw and not na(ibH)
        if na(lnIbH)
            lnIbH := line.new(bar_index, ibH, bar_index, ibH, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cIB, width=2, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnIbH, bar_index, ibH)
    if ibLvlDraw and not na(ibL)
        if na(lnIbL)
            lnIbL := line.new(bar_index, ibL, bar_index, ibL, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cIB, width=2, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnIbL, bar_index, ibL)
    if ibLvlDraw and not na(ib50)
        if na(lnIb50)
            lnIb50 := line.new(bar_index, ib50, bar_index, ib50, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cIB50, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnIb50, bar_index, ib50)
    if sessLvlActive and lonOK and not na(lonH)
        if na(lnLonH)
            lnLonH := line.new(bar_index, lonH, bar_index, lonH, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cLon, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnLonH, bar_index, lonH)
    if sessLvlActive and lonOK and not na(lonL)
        if na(lnLonL)
            lnLonL := line.new(bar_index, lonL, bar_index, lonL, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cLon, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnLonL, bar_index, lonL)
    if sessLvlActive and lonOK and not na(lon50)
        if na(lnLon50)
            lnLon50 := line.new(bar_index, lon50, bar_index, lon50, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cLon50, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnLon50, bar_index, lon50)
    if sessLvlActive and asiaOK and not na(asiaH)
        if na(lnAsH)
            lnAsH := line.new(bar_index, asiaH, bar_index, asiaH, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cAsia, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnAsH, bar_index, asiaH)
    if sessLvlActive and asiaOK and not na(asiaL)
        if na(lnAsL)
            lnAsL := line.new(bar_index, asiaL, bar_index, asiaL, xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=cAsia, width=1, style=line.style_solid)
        else
            line.set_xy2(lnAsL, bar_index, asiaL)

plot(fullVis and i_showVWAP ? vwap : na, "VWAP", color.new(#FF9800,0), 2)

plot(fullVis and i_plotSweepModel and predDominant == 1 and not na(bestLowPx) ? bestLowPx : na, "Model tgt LOW", color.new(#00E676, 35), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(fullVis and i_plotSweepModel and predDominant == -1 and not na(bestHighPx) ? bestHighPx : na, "Model tgt HIGH", color.new(#FF1744, 35), 2, plot.style_linebr)

plot(fullVis and i_showRound ? rndAbove : na, "Rnd up", color.new(#FFD600,50), 1, plot.style_circles)
plot(fullVis and i_showRound ? rndBelow : na, "Rnd dn", color.new(#FFD600,50), 1, plot.style_circles)

plot(fullVis and fibOK ? fib618 : na, ".618", color.new(#9E9E9E,60), 1, plot.style_circles)
plot(fullVis and fibOK ? fib705 : na, ".705", color.new(#9E9E9E,60), 1, plot.style_circles)

plot(i_showSLTP and inLong ? sl : na, "SL", color.new(cRd,40), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_showSLTP and inShort ? sl : na, "SLs", color.new(cRd,40), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_showSLTP and inLong ? tp : na, "TP", color.new(cG,40), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_showSLTP and inShort ? tp : na, "TPs", color.new(cG,40), 2, plot.style_linebr)
plot(i_showSLTP and (inLong or inShort) ? ep : na, "EP", color.new(#FFFFFF,60), 1, plot.style_linebr)

// Raw sweep pattern (fires before filters) — confirms logic is seeing session liquidity sweeps
plotshape(i_showRawSw and bullSweep, "Sweep bull bar", shape.cross, location.belowbar, color.new(cG, 70), size=size.tiny)
plotshape(i_showRawSw and bearSweep, "Sweep bear bar", shape.cross, location.abovebar, color.new(cRd, 70), size=size.tiny)

plotshape(longSig, "Long", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, cG, size=size.normal)
plotshape(shortSig, "Short", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, cRd, size=size.normal)
plotshape(longExit, "ExL", shape.xcross, location.abovebar, cO, size=size.small)
plotshape(shortExit, "ExS", shape.xcross, location.belowbar, cO, size=size.small)
barcolor(longSig ? cG : shortSig ? cRd : na)

var table tabDash = na
tcHead = color.new(#58a6ff, 0)
tcLab = color.new(#8b949e, 0)
tcVal = color.new(#e6edf3, 0)
tcBg = color.new(#0d1117, 8)
tcBr = color.new(#30363d, 25)

// Confirmed bars only — avoids barstate.islast warning with calc_on_every_tick=false
dashLastBar = barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
if dashLastBar
    if not i_showDashTable
        if not na(tabDash)
            table.delete(tabDash)
            tabDash := na
    else
        if na(tabDash)
            tabDash := table.new(position.top_right, 2, 20, border_width=1, frame_color=tcBr, border_color=tcBr, bgcolor=tcBg)
        table.clear(tabDash, 0, 0, 1, 19)
        fr = timeframe.period
        posStr = strategy.position_size > 0 ? "Long" : strategy.position_size < 0 ? "Short" : "Flat"
        bs = bar_index - lastSig
        coolStr = bs > i_cooldown ? "Ready" : str.tostring(i_cooldown + 1 - bs) + " bars"
        wrStr = strategy.closedtrades > 0 ? str.tostring((strategy.wintrades / strategy.closedtrades) * 100, "#.##") + "%" : "—"
        modeStr = usePred ? "Predictive" : "Reactive"
        domStr = predDominant == 1 ? "Bull pool" : predDominant == -1 ? "Bear pool" : "Neutral"
        sessStr = (ibOK ? "IB " : "") + (lonOK ? "Lon " : "") + (asiaOK ? "Asia" : "")
        sessStr := sessStr == "" ? "—" : sessStr
        ddLimitStr = i_maxDdUsd > 0 ? str.tostring(i_maxDdUsd, format.mintick) : "Off"
        riskStatusStr = i_maxDdUsd <= 0 ? "—" : (ddLimitHit ? "BLOCKED" : "OK")
        riskStatusCol = i_maxDdUsd <= 0 ? tcVal : (ddLimitHit ? color.new(cRd, 0) : color.new(color.green, 0))

        // Header
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 0, "Sweep v2", text_color=tcHead, bgcolor=color.new(#161b22, 0), text_size=size.small)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 0, fr, text_color=tcHead, bgcolor=color.new(#161b22, 0), text_size=size.small)
        // Risk (peak equity → current DD vs limit)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 1, "Peak equity", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 1, str.tostring(peakEq, format.mintick), text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 2, "Drawdown $", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 2, str.tostring(ddNowUsd, format.mintick), text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)

        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 13, modeStr, text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)

        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 15, "Model", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 15, domStr + " · " + str.tostring(predConf), text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 16, "Sessions OK", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 16, sessStr, text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 17, "Trades today", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 17, str.tostring(tradesToday) + (i_maxTradesDay > 0 ? " / " + str.tostring(i_maxTradesDay) : ""), text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 18, "Flatten CT", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 18, str.tostring(i_flatHr) + ":" + (i_flatMn < 10 ? "0" : "") + str.tostring(i_flatMn), text_color=tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 0, 19, "After flat", text_color=tcLab, text_size=size.tiny)
        table.cell(tabDash, 1, 19, pastFlat ? "Yes" : "No", text_color=pastFlat ? color.new(cRd, 0) : tcVal, text_size=size.tiny)
